purpose: Does nine-observer R4 EEG select a same-object support photograph with a more faithful normalized foreground outline? First test on generic classes. Two previously studied fixed-word panels proceed to actual JPEG editing only on passing.
population: Same previously registered nine observers as fixed_word_photo_dose, four physical EEG repeats per person. Reuse original 128 generic categories. Sort class IDs, choose first 32 of RNG 260553 permutation as held out. Other 96 fit one fixed model. Ten photographs per held class. Consecutive pairs define five folds. Each query gets the eight remaining images of that held object's class, representing a correctly decoded word. No test pixel in inference. Reuse the original predicted words and donor map if applying to the real panels.
decoder: Use frozen DINOv2-S/14 selected code and center crop. Pool the 16x16 normalized local patch tokens to 4x4. Remove class means on generic fitting classes and fit the first 16 unsupervised principal directions by ordinary PCA. For each of nine people use the original class-centered 1003-feature EEG ridge with regularization 2.0 to predict these 16 scores. Subtract the predicted mean of the eight support EEGs and L2-normalize each participant. Normalize their equal-weight sum. Rank the eight true support patch scores after subtracting their eight-image mean, by cosine. Hard-select one whole support, lowest support ordinal on exact ties.
shape: Segment the center-cropped foreground with the existing fixed U2NetP. Threshold at 0.5. In coordinates centered on the binary foreground centroid and scaled separately by x and y standard deviations, take the 95th radius percentile per 24 angular sectors; empty sectors are periodically interpolated. Smooth the 24 angular log radii with wrapped Gaussian sigma 1 sector, subtract their mean. Measure shape as L1 distance of these normalized log-radius profiles, excluding global location and scale. An angular envelope cannot capture interior holes or all disconnected regions.
controls: Prior medoid minimizes summed contour L1 distance to all eight permitted support profiles. EEG mismatch assigns the legal selection made with the other held query in the same word and fold. Oracle selects the closest of exactly the eight legal support silhouettes using the query foreground only during scoring. Also report random eight-way mean loss and the oracle selecting by real DINO patches only at scoring.
gate: On the 32 fully held generic classes, matched contour error must be smaller than both medoid and exchanged EEG with lower 95% class-bootstrap bounds above zero for control minus matched; equal class weight, 10000 paired draws seed 260554. Report per-photo counts, error, opportunity under legal oracle, and EEG vs true DINO support-choice accuracy. Do not tune after this evaluation. A failed gate stops target rendering. No weak generic demonstration images.
conditional_edit: Only if gate passes: registered and replicate, 120 photographs each, from the existing cohort-9 uniform JPEG with original fixed sub-04 word, crop and recipient seed. Transfer only 35 percent of the selected support's relative log-radius contour to the source's corresponding angles; preserve centroid, axis scales and image borders using smoothly tapering inverse radial mapping. Identical geometry algorithm on matched, medoid and existing same-word/fold rejected-EEG arms, plus neutral re-encoding. No support RGB enters rendering. Score frozen JPEGs independently with DINO, pixels and normalized contour, and fixed row gallery after blind hashes.
